platform.renderer_for_captures: Godot 4.7.1 Forward+ (reference PC) and Compatibility (headless review path)

verified: details pass: fuel flap cut from the right rear quarter as an aperture piece with a 3 mm shut line; third brake light lens on the deck lip
dash pass: hooded binnacle tilted to the driver, bezelled cluster and centre screen, four vents with vanes, start button, wider steering hub
deep metallic navy paint (sRGB 0.11, 0.17, 0.33; metallic 0.50, roughness 0.26) judged by an A/B Forward+ capture against the mid blue
eye point 0.25 m behind the wheel centre; A-pillars, windshield header, sun visors and a roof-following headliner as interior parts; dark glowing screens; neutral suede
tenth vehicle-visual stage: daylight cockpit with a 26-degree pan, validated to use the cockpit camera

redesigned stance on the same contract: belt at 0.65 of the height, a third of the height in glass, fender crests over a dipped hood, fascia headlamp bars above a wider grille, lower deck and tail, exhausts and plate on the rear face, sculpted mirrors, wipers on the cowl, end caps on the bumper covers
tyres split into a plain sidewall material and a tread rolling around the circumference
ninth vehicle-visual stage: a 360-degree walk-around with a 38-degree lens at static ride height, validated to use the chase camera on LOD0

generated scene ships with no texture references; the packer detaches them to a schema-1 sidecar and the wrapper binds those that exist, so the release build (which excludes the rights-gated sourced folder) loads the vehicle untextured instead of failing

third-generation Hero GT: spline-lofted creased Catmull-Clark body to the proportion sheet, panels split with 3 mm shut lines and dark rim walls, conformal grille, intake, headlamp, tail-bar, plate and exhaust apertures, 275/35 R20 tyres on ten-spoke rims with drilled discs and calipers, leather and suede cockpit

ten checksum-locked CC0 texture sets (ambientCG, TextureCan, Poly Haven) packed into the source and embedded in the GLB; extracted composed textures redirected to the rights-gated sourced folder by the packer
unchanged 37-node semantic contract, wheelbase, track, wheel radius, rest length, three LODs, box collision proxy
raised budgets recorded in the exporter; deterministic export, importer-normalised scene with material extras, wrapper validation and schema-1 manifest
wrapper reads material extras to apply the flake clear-coat paint shader, transparent glass, clear-coated carbon and metal
vehicle-visual profile contract on the representative corridor
completion_pending: Q-020 art-direction approval on the new design
rights review of the ten new sourced records (Q-037 extension)
PCK audit stage of verify-vehicle-asset.sh (no Mono export templates on this machine)
excluded_claims: frame-time claims beyond the scenario build budget

acceptance_comparisons.criterion: all 37 semantic nodes resolve through the wrapper

failure_logs: the cockpit eye point sat 3 cm behind the steering wheel rim, so the daylight cockpit stage showed no wheel and a slab of dash; it moved 0.28 m back to the seat
the cockpit camera culls the glass and roof shell, so the cabin read as a convertible until pillars, header and headliner were added as interior parts
the first third-generation cut carried its beltline at 0.98 to 1.03 m and read as a slab-sided wagon in the walk-around; the profiles were redesigned to sports-GT ratios
the walk-around stage did not orbit until the chase rig, which rewrites the arm every frame, was switched off for that stage
the nose end cap handed its upper band to the hood panel, which grew an island with its own dark rim: two dark ovals on the nose
the packaged smoke failed because the generated scene named the rights-gated textures as ext_resources; they are now detached to a sidecar and bound late
an exact boolean on an open panel welds the cutter faces into the result; apertures are now bisected by the cutter planes and the enclosed faces removed
relative exporter paths resolve against the .blend directory; the chain passes absolute paths
the importer extracts embedded textures next to the scene; the packer redirects them to assets/vehicles/sourced/hero-gt/

human_gate.name: Hero vehicle art direction and final rights approval
